summary: Refresh tokens not revoked on logout
description: POST /auth/logout should revoke the refresh token so it can't mint new access tokens. Access tokens still expire in 15 minutes.

summary: make migrate fails on a fresh clone

List DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, JWT_SECRET and the payment-provider keys in setup.md so new joiners can fill .env.
